title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey regulators fined DataOne $1.07 million after inspectors found 62 large natural gas generators running without required permits at its Vineland data center site. The generators, each rated at 2,000 kilowatts, were discovered during a late July visit. State officials said this is the largest penalty ever imposed on a data center operator in New Jersey under the Air Pollution Control Act. The campus is planned as a 2.6 million square foot complex needing 350 megawatts of power, enough for a medium size city, and is set for completion by the end of this year.

Governor Mikie Sherrill said such projects must benefit New Jersey communities. The site has already drawn complaints and a federal lawsuit from homeowners over persistent noise, and the Cumberland County Health Department has issued noise violation orders. The article does not say whether DataOne will appeal the fine or what other enforcement steps may follow.
